theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_coarea_cc_null_of_small_majorants
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (ν : Measure X) (f : X → ℝ) (S : Set X) (M : ℝ≥0∞), M ≠ ∞ → (∀ ε : ℝ≥0, 0 < ε → ∃ (A : ℕ → Set X) (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), S ⊆ ⋃ k, A k ∧ (∀ k, Measurable (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k t, ν (A k ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) ≤ φ k t) ∧ ∑' k, ∫⁻ t, φ k t ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * M) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ν (S ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) = 0
